title: The 1/8 'reserve' does not keep existing sessions refreshing: after new sign-ins are refused, a few rotations fill the file and every refresh (and login) answers 503 again

evidence.command: Tmp501ReserveTest (temporary): FileRefreshTokenStore(f, 32 KB); save new families t<i>/fam<i> until save throws; then for each stored family markUsed(t<i>) + save(t<i>r1, fam<i>) as TokenService.refresh does. ./gradlew :NaruServe-api:test --offline --tests '*Tmp501*' -i | grep TMP501
evidence.output:
TMP501 signed-in families before refusal: 142, file=28520
TMP501 rotations that succeeded: 21 of 142; file=32742; failure=com.snoworca.naruserve.utils.auth.internal.MiniJson$JsonFormatException: the written document is larger than 32768 bytes (the FILE limit)
evidence.intent_output: Class Javadoc (lines 31-33): the last eighth 'stays for the existing sessions' rotations', and the refusal message says 'existing sessions keep refreshing'; so all 142 admitted sessions should be able to refresh. Instead only 21 (15%) can refresh once; the 22nd refresh and every later refresh/login is 503 (TokenService.call -> AuthUnavailableException) until records expire — the M1-F01 end state. At the 8 MB default the same ratio holds (1 MB reserve ~4.6k records vs ~31k admitted families). The failing refresh also leaves its token already markUsed, so the client's retry is treated as reuse and revokes the family.
